description: Compile-only build for a Gradle module + variant (assemble<Variant>). Does not install or launch. Works identically whether you plan to target an emulator or a physical device - both use the same adb, unlike Xcode's simulator/device split.

extraArgs.description: Extra raw Gradle CLI args, e.g. ["--stacktrace"].

module.description: Gradle module path, e.g. ":app". Falls back to sessionDefaults.module.

projectPath.description: Gradle project root. Falls back to sessionDefaults.projectPath.

variant.description: Build variant, e.g. "debug" or "devDebug". Falls back to sessionDefaults.variant.

name: build_device
title: Build (Device)
